sample_unit: patients (154 referred atypia + 140 internal video + 296 external video)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI versus initial biopsy for dysplasia/EGC in internal video set
links.effect: ENAD CAD-G accuracy 88.57% (dysplasia) and 91.43% (EGC) versus 60.71% for initial biopsy results (P<0.001).
links.quote: In the Internal video set, ENAD CAD-G identified dysplasia and EGC with diagnostic accuracies of 88.57% (95% CI, 83.30%-93.84%) and 91.43% (86.79%-96.07%), respectively, compared with an accuracy of 60.71% (52.62%-68.80%) for the initial biopsy results (P<0.001).

links.outcome: AI performance on internal versus external video sets
links.effect: External video set accuracies: EGC 87.50%, dysplasia 90.54%, benign 88.85%, similar to internal set performance.
links.quote: In the External video set, ENAD CAD-G classified EGC, dysplasia, and benign lesions with diagnostic accuracies of 87.50% (83.73%-91.27%), 90.54% (87.21%-93.87%), and 88.85% (85.27%-92.44%), respectively.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of an AI system (ENAD CAD-G) on retrospective internal and external datasets of endoscopic images/videos compared to initial biopsy results.
